testCase:
R-49: Add a $100 gift card for a birthday to my cart.
Goal: Add a $100 gift card for a birthday to my cart.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/r-49/
STEP 2: Click "Only necessary"
STEP 3: Click "Shop gift cards"
STEP 4: Click "Birthday"
STEP 5: Click "$100"
STEP 6: Select "Email to me" in "Delivery"
STEP 7: Click "Add to cart"
STEP 8: Click "Go to cart"
STEP 9: Verify "Cart: 1 x Birthday gift card, $100.00" is visible

plan.title: Add $100 birthday gift card to cart

steps.note: Open the gift card test page.
Set and confirm the requested delivery option.
Add the configured gift card to the cart.
Open the cart to check the added item.
Verify the cart contains one $100 Birthday gift card.

reasoning: This test verifies that a $100 Birthday gift card with Email to me delivery can be added to the cart. The plan follows the specified purchase flow and asserts the exact cart summary to confirm the gift card type, amount, and quantity.
